title: Wuthering Heights

vibeProfile.oneLine: A fierce, doomed love on the Yorkshire moors curdles into revenge.

summary: On the wild Yorkshire moors, the foundling Heathcliff and the wilful Catherine Earnshaw forge a love so fierce it curdles into obsession, cruelty and a revenge that poisons two families across a generation. Emily Bronte's only novel shocked its first readers with its violence and amorality, and remains unlike anything else: a storm-lashed, structurally daring tragedy of passion beyond the grave. Fierce, strange and unforgettable, it is one of the boldest debuts in English literature.
whyReadIt: A storm of a novel about love that turns to obsession and revenge. Fierce, strange, and unlike anything else.

funFacts.text: It was Emily Bronte's only novel; she died the year after it was published.
